description: KML/KMZ Viewer - Professional Geospatial Data Visualization for Power BI Transform your location data into interactive maps directly within your Power BI reports. The KML/KMZ Viewer makes it easy to visualize geographic information without external tools. Key Features: Easy File Import - Simply upload KML or KMZ files and see your data on the map instantly Interactive Maps - Pan, zoom, and explore your geospatial data with professional map controls Multiple Map Types - Choose from Street, Satellite, Google Satellite, Google Hybrid, or Terrain views Layer Management - View all features in an organized panel with show/hide toggles for each item Custom Colors - Change colors for any feature with a simple click Line Thickness Control - Adjust line and border thickness from 1-10 pixels Fit to Feature - Zoom to individual features or fit all features in view with one click Automatic Saving - All your customizations, colors, and settings save automatically Perfect For: ✓ Sales territories and regional analysis ✓ Delivery routes and logistics ✓ Store and facility locations ✓ Real estate properties ✓ Field service areas ✓ Infrastructure mapping ✓ Distribution networks ✓ Geographic planning What You Get: Points, lines, and polygons from your KML files display beautifully on professional maps. Customize everything to match your report theme. All settings persist automatically - no manual…
